card.name: Pre-test restrictions on food, drink, drugs
card.fires_on: Words naming what a patient must avoid before a test or procedure, such as eating, drinking, or taking certain drugs. It fires on the object or verb right after stop, abstain, ingestion of, or nothing to.

modes.description: Eating or drinking words in instructions to hold food or fluids before a procedure.
modes.example: - You may be asked to stop<< eating>> and/or drinking for at least four hours
